instruction: In apps/daemon, when a step runs in a non-git workspace (no workspace repo), Cairn infers hasChanges from transcript tool calls and file diffs. Currently, cross-runtime file-mutating tool names such as write_file, edit_file, create_file, delete_file, apply_patch, notebookedit, replace_file_content, and multi_replace_file_content are not recognized as change tools, and if a shell/command tool modifies files directly on disk without using a recognized edit tool name, hasChanges stays false. Fix non-git workspace change detection and cross-runtime write tool recognition so both cases report hasChanges=true while read-only commands without disk changes still report hasChanges=false.
